scenes.say: Turkey is coming back to Formula One! Istanbul Park returns to the calendar in twenty twenty-seven.
A five-season deal, through twenty thirty-one. The first race is on the third of October.
Istanbul sits in the middle of a triple header: Baku, Istanbul, then Singapore.
The star of the lap is Turn Eight. A long, fast left-hander with four apexes.
The lap is five point three kilometres with fourteen corners, and it runs anti-clockwise.
In twenty twenty, on a wet and slippery track, Hamilton started sixth, won, and took his seventh title.
The last race here, in twenty twenty-one, went to Valtteri Bottas from pole. The track was damp again.
And Istanbul's record man is Felipe Massa: three wins in a row for Ferrari.
Follow the Turkish round on the LapRadar live map.

title: Formula 1 returns to Istanbul: five seasons from 2027 and the legendary Turn 8
